title: Audio-R1: Audio Reasoning through Reinforcement Learning on Self-Supervised Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.34609v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning is increasingly important for large audio-language models (LALMs), yet remains relatively underexplored compared with text-only and vision-language models. We introduce Audio-R1, a reinforcement learning (RL) post-training framework that revisits audio self-supervised learning as a source of verifiable rewards for improving audio understanding and reasoning task performance. Audio-R1 uses answers automatically determined during the construction of self-supervised tasks to verify model responses and compute rewards. Experiments across multiple LALMs and diverse audio benchmarks show consistent performance gains, while ablations demonstrate the benefits of each self-supervised task and additional gains from joint training. While both supervised fine-tuning and Audio-R1 improve self-supervised task accuracy, Audio-R1 further improves performance on downstream tasks distinct from the training tasks. translated_title: Audio-R1：通过强化学习在自监督任务上实现音频推理
translated_abstract: 推理对于大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）而言日益重要，但与纯文本模型和视觉-语言模型相比，其研究仍相对不足。我们提出了Audio-R1，一个强化学习（RL）后训练框架，它重新审视音频自监督学习，将其作为可验证奖励的来源，以提升音频理解和推理任务的性能。Audio-R1利用自监督任务构建过程中自动确定的答案来验证模型的响应并计算奖励。在多个LALM和多样化音频基准上的实验显示出一致的性能提升，消融实验证明了每个自监督任务的益处以及联合训练带来的额外收益。尽管监督微调和Audio-R1都能提高自监督任务的准确率，但Audio-R1还能进一步提升与训练任务不同的下游任务的性能。这些结果凸显了Audio-R1的潜力（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: Audio-R1提出了一种强化学习后训练框架，将音频自监督学习任务作为可验证奖励的来源，有效提升大型音频-语言模型的音频理解与推理能力，并能泛化到与训练任务不同的下游任务。
en_tdlr: Audio-R1 proposes a reinforcement learning post-training framework that leverages audio self-supervised tasks as a source of verifiable rewards to enhance audio understanding and reasoning in large audio-language models, achieving consistent gains and generalizing to downstream tasks distinct from the training tasks.
